title: Triton reduction admission loses storage commitments and singleton result rank

evidence.scope: Read-only parse,assess,lower replay on clean main1b5cca1b. No new native compile,GPU execution or device qualification.

observation: Both retained candidates still report accepted and lowering_eligible at latest reviewed main. LayerNorm reduces the ABI global Buffer directly and emits tl.sum(x.to(float32),axis=0), leaving x a pointer; original toolchain refused pointer conversion. Cosine declares shared singleton reduce outputs but emits plain scalar assignments with no shared access; the next reduce emits axis0 on rank0. An independent all-register singleton double-reduce control reproduces the rank inconsistency without shared storage.
proposed_change: Add localized reduction source/result storage admission at the owning backend unless declared placement is implemented faithfully. Independently make logical singleton result shape consistent across producers/consumers. Test global input,shared result,shared input and legal register chaining separately; do not hide storage loss behind a scalar reshape or impose one backend restriction on every target.
promotion_disposition: Promoted to shared Triton preflight and lowering. Reduction reads and writes require register values because this emitter does not realize reduction memory effects. Logical [1] consumers normalize rank with a size-preserving reshape before the original sum/max and dtype promotion. IR vocabulary, declared arithmetic, reduction tree, and other backend policies are unchanged. No performance gain or wider hardware capability is established.

verified_by.tests: 84 passed: test_triton_reduction_storage, test_triton_loop_scopes, test_emit_triton, test_triton_sequential_regions, test_triton_multi_mma
verified_by.corpus: 204/204 unchanged expectations; 115 lowerable source snapshots checked
verified_by.observed: Original LayerNorm now receives TRITON_REDUCE_STORAGE on operations[3].reads[0]; original Cosine receives the same owning refusal on its three shared writes and three shared reads. All-register double-reduce remains accepted and CPU-emitted execution returns [10] for [1,2,3,4].
verified_by.scope: CPU admission, source control-flow semantics and Corpus only. No new native compilation, device correctness or performance qualification.
